## 正文
````text
name: Windows preview packaging tools

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - '**/*.tex'
      - 'README.md*'
      - 'docs/windows/**'
      - 'source-documents.json*'
      - 'scripts/package_windows_preview.py*'
      - 'scripts/tests/test_windows_preview.py*'
      - '.github/workflows/windows-preview-tools.yml*'
  push:
    paths:
      - '**/*.tex'
      - 'README.md*'
      - 'docs/windows/**'
      - 'source-documents.json*'
      - 'scripts/package_windows_preview.py*'
      - 'scripts/tests/test_windows_preview.py*'
      - '.github/workflows/windows-preview-tools.yml*'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  packaging-tests:
    name: Packaging tests (${{ matrix.os }})
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, windows-latest]
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-python@6d4fd22b20465ccc0f7354476588e8df7c9ca0e0 # v7.1.0
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
      - name: Test packaging tools and launcher fixtures (no Yohaku app launch)
        run: python -B -m unittest discover -s scripts/tests -p test_windows_preview.py -v

  loom-source-check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Build bundled Loom with vendored dependencies
        working-directory: loom-src
        run: cargo build --offline --locked --release --target-dir ../target/loom
      - name: Check authoritative Loom sources against generated text
        run: |
          cp target/loom/release/loom bin/loom-linux-x86_64
          python3 scripts/sync_sources.py --check
````

## 输出与关联
```yaml
output: ".github/workflows/windows-preview-tools.yml"
```
